title: Replication materials for 'Narrating Inflation: How German Economic Journalists Explain Post-Covid Price Rises'
description: Data and code replicating the analyses in "Narrating Inflation: How German Economic Journalists Explain Post-Covid Price Rises" (Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization): anonymized survey responses of German economic journalists and economists, itemized inflation narratives, LLM-coded newspaper segments with validation data, and all figures and tables. Full-text newspaper articles are not included for copyright reasons.
